title: Free Trial Terms for Northgate+ Memberships
content:
Each tier of **Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships** sets whether a free trial exists, how long it runs, how far back the company looks for earlier paid fees, whether a payment method must be on file, and when the conversion reminder goes out.

| Tier | Free trial length (calendar days) | Look-back for earlier settled fees (calendar months before enrollment) | Payment method required to start a trial | Conversion reminder (calendar days before the trial end date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards | 0 | 12 | no | 0 |
| Northgate+ Assist | 0 | 12 | yes | 0 |
| Northgate+ Student | 30 | 12 | yes | 3 |
| Northgate+ Monthly | 30 | 12 | yes | 3 |
| Northgate+ Annual | 30 | 12 | yes | 3 |
| Northgate+ Business | 14 | 12 | yes | 3 |

**Definitions**

- *Free trial length* is the length of the free trial offered to first-time paid members, in calendar days; 0 means no trial is offered.
- *Look-back*: a trial is not offered if any settled membership fee was charged to this customer within this many calendar months before the enrollment date.
- *Payment method required*: whether a payment method must be on file to start a trial.
- *Conversion reminder*: the calendar days before the trial end date on which the conversion reminder is sent; 0 means no reminder because no trial exists.

**Questions the schedule answers**

*Does Northgate+ Assist offer a trial?* No. Its trial length is 0, so no trial is offered and no conversion reminder is sent.

*Which tier has the shortest trial?* Northgate+ Business, at 14 calendar days; Northgate+ Student, Northgate+ Monthly and Northgate+ Annual each run 30 calendar days.

*Hypothetical illustration of the look-back:* for an enrollment on a 20th of a month, the look-back covers settled membership fees charged to the customer within the 12 calendar months before that date; one such fee in that span means no trial is offered on any tier.
